'''Andrew Cirigliano''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 New Jersey State Championship]] on 20 May 2001 with [[Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself|RTP/Death Star Plans]], according to Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2358">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-22-nj-state-champs-20-may-01d2358/ nj-state-champs-20-may-01], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 22 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-22-nj-state-champs-20-may-01d2358/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
